content.comment_body: This is my second [product_name] project. My first experience was very positive, so I'm planning another project. Previously, I built a controller for an aquarium with plants, including DALI-controlled LED lighting, temperature management using a thermistor, and several timed sockets for various accessories used in the hobby. I'm considering using a [article_no] base module without a display, as web administration and logging in through the [product_name] software meet my needs. To save on costs and preserve potential upgrade options, I’m avoiding high-voltage base units. All extension modules remain interchangeable between both projects, allowing for flexibility as requirements evolve. For further cost savings, I’ve looked into a 36W switch mode DIN rail panel mount power supply (24V DC/1.5A), which is much more affordable compared to the [company_name] power supply. Any advice would be appreciated. Thank you, [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: The user is pleased with their prior experience using [product_name], and is now exploring cost-effective approaches for a new project. They are considering alternative power supply options instead of the official [company_name] model while prioritizing module expandability, online management, and compatibility. The user is also cautious about integrating third-party components with the system.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects that [product_name] modules will remain compatible and interchangeable across projects. They are looking for affordable and flexible power supply solutions as well as seamless web-based system administration to support ongoing expansion.
